_comment: Custom labels for the FLEX 7-1 calendar, keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Whatever you put in 'label' replaces what the page would show for that day.
Delete a date's entry to go back to the automatic label.
Optional 'kind' sets the colour: normal | mass | reconciliation | assembly | activity.
This file is never touched by the daily refresh, so edits here stick.
